result.summary: The environment features wide sidewalks and mature street trees in a mixed-use urban setting. However, the primary crossing point in the foreground lacks high-visibility markings, and parked vehicles may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks high-visibility painted markings, making the crossing point less obvious to drivers.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross, especially shorter individuals or children.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility and clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sight lines for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked crosswalks and wide sidewalks. The environment is mixed-use, featuring a multi-story residential/commercial building and a gas station, which introduces multiple vehicle conflict points across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: The gas station on the right creates a wide curb cut where vehicles frequently cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the gas station entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway without a median or refuge island for protection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace the existing textured/faded markings with high-visibility continental-style paint to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with multiple travel lanes and a notable absence of marked crosswalks despite the presence of overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps are provided, the lack of designated crossing markings and the significant crossing distance create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection fails to define a clear path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness of potential crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area across the main roadway

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the main road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with sidewalks and traffic signals but lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is a mix of commercial and residential land uses with on-street parking that may impact visibility.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular traffic lights, which do not provide dedicated walk intervals or countdowns.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection on the right side may block sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.
